sanskrit:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥ ७-२२॥
iast:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān 7-22
translation: Endued with that faith, he engages in the worship of that DEVATA and from it he obtains his desire-fulfilments; all these being ordained, indeed, by Me (alone) .
